fields.title: Vertebroplasty
fields.bodyHtml:
Vertebroplasty is a minimally invasive surgical procedure designed to relieve pain and strengthen weak or damaged vertebrae. The technique is becoming increasingly popular thanks to its effectiveness and safety. It is particularly useful in treating osteoporosis, cancers of the spine and injuries.

Symptoms

The main symptoms indicating that vertebroplasty may be needed are:

  • Chronic back pain that worsens with movement or exertion;
  • Loss of height because of compression of the vertebrae;
  • Restricted movement and flexibility of the spine;
  • Increased pain when lying down.

Methods of diagnosis

Diagnosis involves a set of investigations, including:

  • X-rays of the spine;
  • Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI);
  • Computed tomography (CT);
  • Bone densitometry to assess bone density.

Methods of treatment

The vertebroplasty procedure involves injecting a special bone cement into the damaged vertebra under X-ray guidance. The cement sets quickly, stabilising the vertebra and considerably reducing the pain.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel occupies a leading position in world medicine thanks to:

  • The use of advanced technology and innovative treatments;
  • Highly qualified medical staff;
  • An individual approach to every patient;
  • Modern diagnostic equipment;
  • Shorter recovery times and minimal complications.

Conclusion

Vertebroplasty is an effective and safe way of relieving pain and strengthening the spine. The procedure helps patients return quickly to an active life and improves their quality of life. Treatment in Israel offers advanced technology and a high standard of medical care, which makes it one of the best choices for this kind of operation.

fields.title: Stomach ulcer
fields.bodyHtml:
Stomach ulcer: advanced treatment in Israel

A stomach ulcer is a chronic condition in which deep defects (ulcers) form in the lining of the stomach, causing pain, discomfort and other serious symptoms. Israeli clinics offer a comprehensive approach to treating this condition, including modern diagnostic procedures, individualised drug treatment and, where necessary, surgery.

Diagnosis of a stomach ulcer:

  1. Gastroscopy (upper gastrointestinal endoscopy)
    The main diagnostic method, allowing the inner surface of the stomach to be seen and a biopsy taken for examination.
  2. Tests for Helicobacter pylori
    Detection of the bacterium often associated with the development of ulcers, using a breath test, a blood test or tissue taken during endoscopy.
  3. Barium X-ray of the stomach
    Used to image the stomach and identify changes in its outline and function.

Treatments for a stomach ulcer:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) and H2 receptor blockers: Reduce the production of stomach acid, creating the conditions for the ulcer to heal.
    • Medicines to eradicate Helicobacter pylori: A combination of antibiotics and a PPI to destroy the bacterium where it is present.
    • Medicines to protect the lining of the stomach: Sucralfate, for example, which creates a protective layer over the surface of the ulcer.
  2. Surgery:
    • Used where drug treatment is ineffective, or where there are complications (bleeding, perforation, narrowing of the outlet of the stomach).

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A high standard of diagnosis: The use of advanced technology and highly qualified specialists for accurate diagnosis and to establish the best treatment strategy.
  • An individual approach to treatment: Medicines and treatments are chosen according to the patient's individual circumstances and the nature of the condition.
  • Scientific advances brought into clinical practice: The use of the latest scientific developments to make treatment more effective and shorten patients' recovery time.
  • Multidisciplinary medical teams: Gastroenterologists, surgeons, infectious disease specialists and others work together to provide a comprehensive approach to treatment.
  • Modern medical facilities: Clinics are equipped with state-of-the-art technology, which allows highly accurate diagnostic and treatment procedures in comfortable conditions for patients.
  • Support and rehabilitation: As well as active treatment, considerable attention is given to the patient's recovery and continued health afterwards, including dietary advice and psychological support.

Treatment of a stomach ulcer in Israel is aimed at achieving lasting remission and the greatest possible improvement in patients' quality of life. With an individual approach and the use of innovative treatments, patients can considerably reduce the symptoms of the condition and prevent complications.

fields.title: Ankle replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Ankle replacement: innovative approaches in Israel

Ankle replacement is a high-technology operation aimed at restoring function and relieving pain in an ankle joint damaged by arthritis, injury or other conditions. In Israel, patients have access to advanced treatments that achieve excellent results and considerably improve quality of life.

Investigations before ankle replacement

  1. Clinical examination
    Assessment of the pain, the degree of restricted movement and the effect of the state of the joint on the patient's daily life.
  2. X-rays
    Allow assessment of the degree of degenerative change in the joint and the presence of deformity and erosions.
  3. MRI and CT
    Used for detailed imaging of the soft tissues, cartilage and bones around the ankle.
  4. Laboratory tests
    May be ordered to rule out systemic inflammatory conditions.

Methods of ankle replacement in Israel

  1. Total ankle replacement
    Replacement of the damaged joint with an artificial implant that reproduces its natural function and relieves the pain.
  2. Partial replacement
    May be carried out where only one part of the joint is damaged.
  3. Minimally invasive techniques
    Used to shorten recovery time and minimise the risk of complications.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • Highly qualified specialists: Israeli orthopaedic surgeons have rich experience in joint replacement, including of the ankle.
  • Advanced medical equipment: The use of modern prostheses and technology, which makes the operation highly precise and the implant long-lasting.
  • An individualised approach: Every patient is given a personal treatment plan based on their clinical picture and particular needs.
  • Comprehensive rehabilitation: Includes individually designed physiotherapy and rehabilitation programmes to speed up recovery and the return to normal life.

Ankle replacement in Israel gives patients the chance to be rid of chronic pain, restore mobility and return to an active life. Thanks to the comprehensive approach to treatment and the use of the latest advances in medical science, ankle replacement surgery in Israel is a highly effective solution for people suffering from serious joint conditions.

fields.title: Elbow replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Elbow replacement: innovative approaches in Israel

Elbow replacement in Israel is an advanced procedure designed to improve the quality of life of patients suffering from severe pain and restricted movement because of arthritis, injury or other conditions of the elbow. Thanks to its international standing in orthopaedics and its use of modern technology, Israel offers effective solutions for restoring the function of the elbow joint.

Investigations before elbow replacement

  1. Physical examination
    Assessment of the degree of pain, the mobility and stability of the joint, and the effect of the state of the joint on the patient's daily life.
  2. X-rays
    Allow the degree of damage to the joint and the presence of deformity or bony growths to be established.
  3. MRI and CT
    Used for more detailed imaging of the soft tissues and bones around the elbow, and help identify hidden damage.
  4. Electromyography (EMG)
    May be ordered to assess the state of the nerves passing through the elbow, where neurological problems are suspected.

Methods of elbow replacement

  1. Total elbow replacement
    Complete replacement of the elbow joint with an artificial implant; recommended for patients with serious destruction of the joint.
  2. Partial replacement
    Replacement of one component of the elbow joint; can be effective where the damage is localised.
  3. Revision replacement
    Replacement of an existing prosthesis with a new one; needed where the implant has worn out or there have been complications after a previous operation.
  4. Arthroscopy
    A minimally invasive procedure for treating damage inside the joint.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • Highly qualified specialists
    Israeli orthopaedic surgeons have extensive experience in complex operations on the elbow joint and regularly update their knowledge by taking part in international congresses and exchanges.
  • Advanced medical equipment
    The use of the most modern prostheses and replacement techniques, including minimally invasive methods that allow rapid recovery.
  • An individualised approach
    Every treatment plan is developed individually, taking account of the patient's anatomy and the demands of their life.
  • Comprehensive rehabilitation
    Multimodal rehabilitation programmes designed to speed up recovery and the return to normal life.

Elbow replacement in Israel is a modern solution for those who want to be rid of pain and restore the function of the arm. Patients can expect a high standard of medical care, attentive treatment and an individual approach.

fields.title: Shoulder replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Shoulder replacement: advanced techniques in Israel

Shoulder replacement in Israel is an innovative area of orthopaedics that offers patients with osteoarthritis, arthritis or injuries of the shoulder the chance to improve their quality of life considerably. Using advanced technology and an individual approach, Israeli clinics deliver highly effective treatment and rapid recovery.

Investigations before shoulder replacement

  1. Physical examination
    The doctor carries out a thorough examination and takes a history in order to establish the degree of loss of function in the joint and the extent of the pain.
  2. X-rays
    Needed to assess the degree of damage to the joint and establish the form and extent of the arthritic changes.
  3. MRI
    Provides detailed images of the soft tissues of the joint, including the cartilage, tendons and ligaments.
  4. Computed tomography (CT)
    Used for a more precise assessment of the bony structures.

Methods of shoulder replacement

  1. Total shoulder replacement
    Replacement of the whole shoulder joint with an artificial one. This is the recommended method where the joint is seriously damaged.
  2. Partial replacement
    Replacement of the head of the humerus only. It can be effective where the damage is limited.
  3. Reverse shoulder replacement
    Used in patients with serious damage to the rotator cuff. This method restores the function of the joint by changing its anatomical structure.
  4. Arthroscopy
    A minimally invasive procedure for treating damage inside the joint.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • An individualised approach
    Every patient is offered treatment adapted as closely as possible to their individual needs and general health.
  • Highly qualified specialists
    Israeli orthopaedic surgeons have rich experience in joint replacement and use the most modern techniques in their practice.
  • Modern medical equipment
    Operations are carried out using the latest advances in medical technology and high-quality prostheses.
  • Minimally invasive techniques
    The use of minimally invasive methods shortens recovery time and reduces the risk of complications.

Treatment and replacement of the shoulder joint in Israel is a byword for a high standard of medical care, an individual approach and the use of innovative technology that delivers the best treatment results. Patients who choose Israel for shoulder replacement surgery can expect attentive treatment and quality medical care.

Recovery and rehabilitation after the operation

Recovery after shoulder replacement in Israel involves a comprehensive approach to rehabilitation, which begins immediately after the operation and aims at a rapid return of movement and strength in the shoulder. The rehabilitation programme usually includes:

  • Physiotherapy: Prescribed to improve the range of movement and strengthen the muscles around the new joint.
  • Occupational therapy: Helps the patient adapt to everyday tasks and return to normal life.
  • Individual exercises: Designed to restore the function of the shoulder and prevent possible complications.
  • Pain relief: Used to control pain in the period after the operation.

Innovations in treatment

Israel is actively introducing innovative approaches into the treatment of orthopaedic conditions, including the development and use of biocompatible materials for prostheses, which give the implant a longer working life and reduce the risk of rejection. Attention is also being given to the development of 3D printing technology to create individualised prostheses adapted as closely as possible to each patient's anatomy.

Choosing Israel for shoulder replacement surgery guarantees not only access to advanced medical technology and highly qualified specialists but also a comprehensive approach to treatment and rehabilitation, which aids the quickest possible recovery and return to an active life.
